method: Imported V2 validator via importlib.util.spec_from_file_location; built/mutated states in memory (deep copies / from-scratch schema-valid states); called validate_state(state, V2 policy, V2 schema); exercised loader via patched Path.read_bytes with in-memory bytes; exercised CLI via subprocess on read-only V2 fixtures; compared with V1 validator called read-only on V1 adversarial fixtures. findings.title: Discouraged Research Owner+Moderator passes with warning only

control_source_lines.quote:
"discouraged_combinations": [
  {"roles": ["RESEARCH_OWNER", "MODERATOR"], "classification": "NOT_RECOMMENDED", "review_requirement": "product_owner_combination_review", "code": "E-DISCOURAGED-RO-MODERATOR"}, ...]

independent_check.method: In-memory state built from scratch (6 candidates); RO and MODERATOR assigned to C1; all combination_approvals removed; validate_state(state, V2 policy, V2 schema)

findings.assessment: Vulnerable path unreachable: combination is an ERROR and the governing dimension is FAIL; no warning-only path. Nuance: if a matching approval record exists but outcome=REJECTED, E-DISCOURAGED-RO-MODERATOR is suppressed by 'not ca', but E-COMBINATION-APPROVAL-REJECTED still fails product_owner_combination_approval and stage_b=False (verified).

findings.title: Boolean evidence flag without evidence reference accepted

control_source_lines.quote: "conditional_combinations": [{"roles": ["MODERATOR", "NOTE_TAKER"], "classification": "CONDITIONAL", "requirement": "evidence_separation", "code": "E-COND-EVIDENCE-SEPARATION"}, ...]
evidence record requires evidence_id, evidence_type, source_ref, content_hash, recording_authority, timestamp, verification_status, subject; additionalProperties=false

independent_check.method: In-memory state; MOD+NOTE on C3 with a valid exact combination approval but no EVIDENCE_SEPARATION record; second probe injects legacy boolean conditional_evidence at state level

findings.assessment: Boolean cannot satisfy the condition: the check requires a VERIFIED EVIDENCE_SEPARATION record with exact subject 'candidate:PAIRKEY'; injecting the legacy boolean produces an additional E-SCHEMA error. Caveat from residual observation R-1: generic evidence_check() ERRORs do not flip evidence_integrity to FAIL, though stage_b_role_ready stays False.

authoritative_source.charter: M001_ROLE_ASSIGNMENT_DECISION_PACK/M001_RESEARCH_ROLE_CHARTER.md lines 14-25: 'Not recommended' (RO+M, DC+A), 'Unacceptable' (M+A, M+DC), 'Acceptable with documentation' (M+N), 'Acceptable only if explicitly appointed' (RO+CS), and 'One person may hold multiple roles only where explicitly documented by the Product Owner.'
authoritative_source.staffing_pack: M001_TEAM_STAFFING_PACK/M001_MINIMUM_TEAM_STAFFING_MODELS.md lines 9-18 uses UNACCEPTABLE / NOT RECOMMENDED / 'Conditionally acceptable with documented evidence separation' / 'explicit appointment'; line 32 requires written evidence-separation procedure.
assessment: V1's DISCOURAGED wording was not the authoritative wording; V2's NOT_RECOMMENDED matches the packs, but V2 changed advisory 'not recommended' into a blocking error (per audit-register correction, not per the packs).
V2's source field now lists the audit defect register as a policy source - remediation provenance is self-referential rather than purely governance-authoritative.
No override mechanism appears in authoritative source; V2 invents none for hard incompatibilities.

V2 invents a precise machine schema for 'Product Owner combination review': exact sorted role set, outcome APPROVED, product_owner_approved=true, non-empty rationale, timezone-aware decision_timestamp, and a COMBINATION_REVIEW evidence record with source_ref, 64-hex content_hash, recording_authority, verification_status VERIFIED and subject literally 'candidate:PAIRKEY'. Authoritative source only says 'explicitly documented by the Product Owner'.

Several V2 policy fields are declarative only and are never read by validator.py: missing_appointment_states, require_combination_approval_for_multi_role, evidence_fields, timestamp_fields, review_requirement. The engine reads discouraged_combinations[].code but not its classification string. Changing these policy values would not change engine behaviour.

residual_observations.title: evidence_check() ERRORs do not flip evidence_integrity dimension
residual_observations.evidence: source lines 217-246 append Issue('ERROR', ..., 'evidence_integrity', ...) without calling fail(); lines 279-282 are the only dimension setter. Demonstrated: forged combination evidence id -> E-EVIDENCE-UNKNOWN, evidence_integrity=PASS, blocking_error_count=1; bad content hash -> E-EVIDENCE-HASH, evidence_integrity=PASS. stage_b_role_ready stays False because line 452 requires 'not issues'.
residual_observations.impact: Machine consumers reading the dimensions object alone can be misled; only stage_b_role_ready / issues are trustworthy.

residual_observations.title: Policy is partly inert / self-referential source
residual_observations.evidence: grep of V2 validator.py found no use of missing_appointment_states, require_combination_approval_for_multi_role, evidence_fields, timestamp_fields or review_requirement; classification strings are not read; policy source field includes the audit defect register.
residual_observations.impact: Policy-version changes may not be enforced; authoritative provenance is mixed.

residual_observations.title: Discouraged-block suppression by any matching approval record
residual_observations.evidence: line 433 suppresses E-DISCOURAGED-* when approval_map has a record for the exact key, even if outcome=REJECTED. Verified probe: E-COMBINATION-APPROVAL-REJECTED is emitted instead, product_owner_combination_approval=FAIL, stage_b=False.
residual_observations.impact: Specific E-DISCOURAGED code is not a reliable signal on its own; no security regression because another blocking error fires.

residual_observations.title: Hard incompatibilities are genuinely unoverridable
residual_observations.evidence: lines 429-431 emit E-HARD-* unconditionally when the pair is held, independent of ca. Verified with fully valid approvals for MOD+ANALYST and MOD+DATA_CUSTODIAN: both E-HARD-* emitted, role_compatibility=FAIL, stage_b=False. No override field exists in policy V2 or in the V2 schema.
